name: audio_single_recording_finish
description: One batch-lane recording from a committed synthetic WAV (macOS say, two voices, 8.9 s), Finish tapped at 8.5 s while capturing, fast finish on. Its words come from the STT cassette for that exact audio (a committed synthetic one unless a local or vendor cassette was recorded) and pass through the batch lane's real PipelineWorker and projection before landing. The Finish conversation is visible on Home from the provisional transcript on.
